summary: Human Resource Manager adding value by contributing to company growth and profitability. Trusted adviser and strategic business partner. Efficient in developing and implementing HR plans and procedures. Promotes team-oriented, open-door environments conducive to successful workforce. Highly motivated to achieve company goals.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Address employee inquiries and management regarding new-hire activity and ongoing employee relation issues.
Advise top management on appropriate employee corrective actions.
Facilitate regular meetings to develop strategies that positively influence workplace relationships.
Recruit and interview applicants daily.
Implement employee recognition and incentive program.
Generate employee tracking reports weekly.
Work with senior-level management to create fair and consistent HR policies and procedures.

experience.title: Human Resource Manager
responsibilities: Support 12 units with over 1000 employees.
Analyze staffing needs and develop recruitment, training, and retention strategies.
Create and utilize job descriptions.
Facilitate meetings to develop workplace relationship strategies.
Handle new hire paperwork compliance.
Advise management on hiring practices and succession planning.
Create fair HR policies and procedures.
Review federal and state laws for compliance.
Advise on employee corrective actions.
Guide background checks and reference verification.
Manage employee performance evaluation and merit program.
Address employee relation inquiries.
Prepare EEOC responses.
Conduct respectful workplace investigations.
Monitor policy compliance.
Coordinate performance reviews and development plans.
Process salary changes.
Partner with asset protection for compliance training.
Promote quality customer service.

experience.title: Front End Supervisor

Ensure program compliance to maximize customer satisfaction.

experience.title: Customer Service Technical Trainer
responsibilities: Develop documentation for common processes.
Train employees on company protocols.
Research issues to resolve complaints.
Provide technical support.

experience.title: Bakery Manager
